title: Instagram Passed Twitter's Users In 2 Years
source: Instagram's own publicly announced monthly-active-user milestones: 30 million at the 2012 Facebook acquisition, 100 million (Feb 2013), 300 million (Dec 2014), 400 million (Sept 2015), 500 million (June 2016), 800 million (Sept 2017), 1 billion (June 2018). Twitter's year-end monthly active users are its investor-reported figures as widely compiled (185 million in 2012 rising to 330 million in 2017, dipping to 321 million in 2018). Figures approximate to the reporting year.
